claim: Aquarium de La Rochelle adult admission is €18.50 (€16.50 reduced), teens 13-17 €14.50, children 3-12 €12.50, under 3 free, and time-stamped online tickets are strongly advised to guarantee entry.
quote: Only the purchase of time-stamped tickets on our website ensures access to the visit on the day and at the time chosen.

claim: The Aquarium's official estimated visit duration is about 1.5 hours and it opens daily, with high-season hours (April-July) of 9am to 8pm (last entry 6:30pm).
quote: From Thursday, April 2 to Sunday, July 5, 2026, the Aquarium is open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. (last entry at 6:30 p.m.)

claim: Tripadvisor reviewers commonly report spending about 2 hours, and up to 2-3 hours, to see the Aquarium fully.
quote: Multiple Tripadvisor reviews mention 'about 2 hours of visit'; some report it should take 'two to three hours to see it all'.

claim: The Musée Maritime de La Rochelle, whose heritage fleet includes the France 1 weather frigate and the Angoumois trawler, sells a combined ticket with the Towers of La Rochelle for €15, with free admission under 18 and on the first Sunday of each month outside July-August.
quote: A combined ticket costs 15€ (one entry to the Maritime Museum + the Towers of La Rochelle), with free admission for visitors under 18 ... Free entry for all visitors on the 1st Sunday of each month, except July-August.

claim: Le Bunker de La Rochelle, a preserved WWII U-boat officers' command bunker built secretly in the town centre in 1941, charges €7 adult and €5.50 child and opens daily 10am-6pm from April 2026.
quote: Les tarifs sont : adulte 7 euros et enfant 5,5 euros. ... le musée est ouvert tous les jours de 10h à 18h (dernières admissions).

claim: The Musée du Nouveau Monde (10 rue Fleuriau) costs €8 full / €5 reduced, opens Tuesday-Sunday 10h-12h30 and 13h30-17h30, closed Mondays; a 3-museum combined ticket including the Maritime Museum is €18 and a 3-month municipal pass-musées is €12.
quote: Musée du Nouveau Monde ... Admission Fees: €8 (full price), €5 (reduced) ... combined ticket for 3 museums ... €18 ... pass-musées (€12 full price – €8 reduced).

claim: The Musée d'Orbigny-Bernon (2 rue Saint-Côme) is a municipal museum priced at €8 full / €5 reduced with Tuesday-Sunday 10h-12h30 / 13h30-17h30 hours.
quote: Musée d'Orbigny-Bernon ... Tuesday to Sunday: 10h-12h30 / 13h30-17h30; Closed Mondays and public holidays ... €8 (full price), €5 (reduced).

claim: The Musée des Beaux-Arts de La Rochelle is closed for renovation works as of 2026 with no published reopening date.
quote: Le musée est actuellement fermé pour travaux.

claim: The Musée des Automates and Musée des Modèles Réduits closed on 5 November 2023 for relocation and have not published a reopening date or current status.
quote: Les Musées des Automates et des Modèles Réduits de La Rochelle ferment leurs portes à partir du 05/11/2023 pour déménagement ... Informations complémentaires à venir prochainement.
